subject: [hw] DONE X01 rev 2: 439/439 (failed-read coverage; commit f31a405)
body:
DONE X01 rev 2. Host-only; no phone, no publish, no daemon edit.

    bash gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST X01 PASS 439/439

Since rev 1:
- errors mode now covers a failed READ on an unpowered window: rc/done forwarded exactly, log line `R VENC 0x0010 ? -> -13`, no invented value; 41/41 per ASan/O2 config.
- Python check: log2script parses that failed read, emits no read rule and no warning; 35/35.
- README CRC example corrected to the CRC of 16 zero bytes (0xecbb4b55), separate from the 123456789 anchor (0xcbf43926).

Counts: asan 36+36+36+41+14, o2 36+36+36+41+14, tsan 36+14, cap0 9+9, python 35, shell diffs + iOS freestanding compile. Literal expected log byte-identical; log2script replay reproduces the full 29-line log; diff_logs exact mutant line; no TSan report. Commits: 0bbb7ae, e61975a, f31a405 (hwlog/** + dsh-state/workers/X01/STATUS.md only).

Not done unchanged: no phone run; hw-ip hook + `_fileno` pending; no real vendor log yet; documented POLL/IRQ/DMA/T02-0x3000 limits. Staying available for review findings.
